text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yup,
the results of this review meeting are—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: There seem to be some harsh critiques pointing out that certain aspects didn't align with the construction plan, however...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Looks like building relaxation facilities that make the most of nature was well received.
All credit goes to City for the suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Dahaha! Starting with City, all of your hard work has been a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"The next evaluation meeting is in late June!
What we built has gotten even better!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Let's keep this momentum going and build even higher-level facilities!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much we can do!
From here on out, we're shifting into an even higher gear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 2nd Tracen Island Evaluation concluded!
Now, what should the next construction plan be...!
